facts.fact: Burkina Faso's national AI roadmap 2026-2030 was validated on 19 June 2026 after ten months of work, and its official publication is still awaited, according to Dr Yaya Traore of the digital-transition ministry.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso plans AI models for Moore, Dioula and Fulfulde under its AI roadmap, and Dr Yaya Traore says agreements have been signed with the national broadcaster RTB to collect the language data needed.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso's AI roadmap 2026-2030 aims for national hosting of at least 80% of the data concerned and for its data and models to stay under state control and ownership, Dr Yaya Traore said.
